source.title: Volvo Truck Corporation, D13A Design and Function, Service Bulletin 200 281 01, 02.2006
source.access: HTML text on third-party mirror; source drawings not inspected or reproduced

assets.scope: 12 numbered elements, subsystem grouping, textual locations and EMS logic. Positions are list indices, not connector pins.
EMS start permission, EECU/VECU and start relay; not a power circuit.
Inner drive: alternator and A/C; outer drive: fan and coolant pump. Two engine ground locations. No belt routing or charging schematic.

limitations: Not exact installation or electrical schematic; check authorized Volvo documentation by VIN, engine variant and group 33, obtain component photos, review SVG rendering and expert signoff before publication.
